author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
Jay returns triumphantly with his GUNNERS to take on my freshly painted Brotherhood of Steel in a Fallout Factions story in GNR Square. Will Galaxy News Radio fall to the raiders or will the Brotherhood safeguard this repository of broadcasting technology!

Check out Fallout Factions HERE: https://modiphius.net/products/fallout-factions-core-rulebook

Check out the downloads for the additional rules HERE: https://modiphius.net/pages/fallout-factions-downloads
